errors.evidence: The description states the range of the vertical axis is from 0% to 8%, but the axis is mirrored, extending from 8% at the top to 8% at the bottom, passing through 0%. This omits the entire negative portion of the axis used to display the '现汉比例' data.

errors.text_span: 每个类别包含两根柱状图
errors.evidence: The chart does not show two separate bars per category in a typical grouped fashion. Instead, for each category, one bar extends upwards from the zero line and another extends downwards. Describing them as two separate bars ('两根柱状图') misrepresents this key structural aspect.
